title: About Me
content:
I'm an Economics and statistics student at Chuka University building a career in data science. I combine statistical thinking with Python, SQL, Excel, Power BI and machine learning to turn raw data into clear, usable findings, and I’m currently deepening my machine learning skills through hands-on study and projects.

My work spans finance and climate. I designed FinSight AI, a behavioral credit-scoring framework for African micro-entrepreneurs, and built Resilience Capital, a climate-adaptive lending platform that links drought forecasting to loan pricing. I also placed 3rd at the SEKU Regional Data Science Hackathon, where I applied my analytical skills to a real data challenge.


I’m looking for data analysis, research, and fintech opportunities where I can apply what I know and keep growing.
